what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in Kenya, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 28874 Ethiopian refugees in Kenya, 17.6% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Eritrea territory in Ethiopia from 1970 to 1991 and over the government of Ethiopia from 1976 to 1991, at war level in many of those years.
It also records armed conflict over Oromiya territory in many periods, most recently with the OLA from 2019 to 2025, and over the government with the TPLF and GLF from 2020 to 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1975 at 300 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 68633, at the end of 1992, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Kenya.
These are year-end totals for Kenya only, reported to UNHCR.
